venues.name: Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Open Monday and Friday from 10AM to 4PM. On show days we will be open at 10AM.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Pick up tickets 2 hours prior to show. CUSTOMER MUST PRESENT THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PLACE ORDER AND A PHOTO I.D. located at the Box Office adjacent to main gates. Internet & phone orders (with will call option selected) will be available for pickup beginning at approximately 2 hours prior to show time. Customer will be required to present photo id and actual credit card used to purchase tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: All parking lots are adjacent to Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach. Parking lots open an hour before the scheduled gate time. General admission parking comes with your ticket. If you want easier entry and exit, go for Premier Parking or VIP Parking at point of purchase. Limited spaces available in Premier Parking and VIP Parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating available at Box Office at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach, tm on line, charge by phone and all ticket centers. For additional information please visit: https://www.veteransunitedhomeloansamphitheater.com/accessibility *** Ticket purchases for sight & hearing impaired patrons should be directed to Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater - ticket office at the venue. Call (757) 368-3000 *** The accessible sections at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach can accommodate wheelchairs, gurneys, crutches, walkers and other modes of accessibility.

generalInfo.generalRule: All items are subject to change per artist restrictions. NO bottles, coolers, or pets. NO weapons or recording devices are permitted. Blankets and cushions are allowed (restricted on some shows). Your safety and security are most important to us. The following link will take you to our venue's guidelines: https://www.veteransunitedhomeloansamphitheater.com/visit#get-here Permitted Items Inside Venue (all items are subject to change at tour's request) · 1 sealed bottle of water per person · Food in a clear 1 gallon sized plastic bag · Personal camera (No professional cameras, No Video or audio recording) · Umbrellas · Purses · Blankets · Lawn Chairs · bags/backpacks (All bags/backpacks will be subject to search)
